item.title: Lucknow Super Giants Reveal New Logo Ahead Of IPL 2026
item.description: Lucknow Super Giants have launched a new logo featuring Garuda, the Crown, and the Elephant ahead of IPL 2026. The franchise said the design reflects courage, pride, strength, and the strong support of their fans.
